proofs.CouretOaiBridge01.rationalToReal_sigma:
by
  simp only [sigma, sigmaR, inverseNumerator, inverseNumeratorR,
    delta, deltaR, smul_sub, smul_add, MonoidAlgebra.smul_single]
  norm_num [rationalToReal, smul_eq_mul]
proofs.CouretOaiBridge01.tauR_convolution_apply:
by
  have hsingle (u : U30) :
      (MonoidAlgebra.single u (1 : ℝ) * x).coeff r =
        x.coeff (u⁻¹ * r) := by
    change (MonoidAlgebra.single u (1 : ℝ) * x) r = x (u⁻¹ * r)
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      (MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_apply x (1 : ℝ) u r)
  simp [tauR, deltaR, add_mul, hsingle]
proofs.CouretOaiBridge01.sigmaR_convolution_app:
by
  have hsingle (u : U30) :
      (MonoidAlgebra.single u (1 : ℝ) * x).coeff r =
        x.coeff (u⁻¹ * r) := by
    change (MonoidAlgebra.single u (1 : ℝ) * x) r = x (u⁻¹ * r)
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      (MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_apply x (1 : ℝ) u r)
  simp [sigmaR, inverseNumeratorR, deltaR, sub_mul, add_mul, two_mul, hsingle]

proofs.Couret.Strobo2Tors.orderedRep_three:
by
  classical
  have hca : c ≠ a := Ne.symm hac
  have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
  have hbc : b ≠ c := Ne.symm hcb
  unfold orderedRep
  rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.sum_product]
  simp [hac, hab, hcb, hca, hba, hbc, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] <;> omega
